raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Megatron-Bridge `main` already resolves Pillow 13.0.0 in `uv.lock`, but the NeMo Framework image still explicitly installs Pillow 12.3.0 through `fw_pyproject.toml` and permits it in the Dockerfile's system-pip layer. That can leave the image with a vulnerable copy despite the Bridge lockfile.

Require Pillow >=13.0.0 in both Framework image install paths through a normal uv constraint and the system-pip install. This version fixes the seven Pillow findings reported by the 26.10 source scan, including CVE-2026-112393, CVE-2026-112896, CVE-2026-112900, CVE-2026-112396, CVE-2026-112404, CVE-2026-112403, and CVE-2026-112398.

Validation: the existing Bridge lockfile resolves Pillow 13.0.0; `uv run --no-sync pre-commit run --all-files` and `git diff --check` passed. A rebuilt image scan on amd64 and arm64 remains necessary to verify installed copies.

The inherited Bridge lockfile already resolves that version.

Static review only; image builds and vulnerability scans were not executed.

### Suggested test cases
- `fw_final_pillow_floor_amd64` (proposed): rebuild the amd64 image; verify Pillow >=13.0.0 in both virtualenv and system installations, confirm a PNG encode/decode round-trip, and scan for older copies.
- `fw_final_pillow_floor_arm64` (proposed): repeat those checks on arm64 with the same expected results.
- No perf tests impacted.

> **Note:** formal approval is not available for this request, so this review is posted as a comment only.

detail.title: build(security): pin Pillow 13.0.0 in Framework image

files.patch:
@@ -47,6 +47,7 @@ test = ["coverage>=7.8.1"]
 
 [tool.uv]
 prerelease = "allow"
+constraint-dependencies = ["pillow>=13.0.0"]
 override-dependencies = [
     # Force core libraries to be installed from the local paths
     "megatron-core[dev,mlm]; sys_platform == 'never'", # Installed by MBridge
@@ -73,7 +74,6 @@ override-dependencies = [
     "urllib3>=2.0.7",
     "sh==2.2.4",
     "jupyter-core==5.8.1",
-    "pillow==12.3.0",
     "protobuf==6.33.5",
     "cuda-python>=13.0.0",
     "multi-storage-client!=0.36.0",
